title: College Football
description:
Michigan at Rutgers
The Scarlet Knights (2-5) host the Wolverines (4-3) at SHI Stadium for a Big Ten game. The Wolverines fell 13-6 to the Hoosiers and relies on QB Bryce Underwood. The Scarlet Knights lost 42-14 to the Wildcats and look to QB Dylan Lonergan.

title: B1G  Football Game Break

title: College Football
description:
Purdue at Penn State
The Purdue Boilermakers (3-4) visit the Penn State Nittany Lions (3-4) for a Big Ten matchup at Beaver Stadium. Purdue fell 38-26 to Washington and relies on Ryan Browne, while Penn State seeks to snap a four-game skid after a 21-18 loss to Michigan.

title: B1G  Football Game Break

title: College Football
description:
Washington at Nebraska
The Huskies (4-3) visit the Cornhuskers (5-2) at Memorial Stadium for a Big Ten matchup. Washington beat Purdue 38-26 behind quarterback Elijah Brown. Nebraska seek to snap a two-game skid and fell to Oregon 17-14 and relies on Anthony Colandrea.
